Let us Explore
 Do you know what a bank account is?
 It is a safe place to keep your money, just like you
 keep your money safe in a gullak.

 Suppose you get ` 50 for your birthday every
 year. You put it into your Savings Account.
 After a year, the bank adds ` 5 more. This is
 called interest on the Savings Account.

 Benefits of a Savings Account:
 • Meant for saving money.
 • You can add or withdraw money anytime.
 • As a reward for saving, you earn interest.

 1. Do you have a bank account? Yes/ No
 2. Find out more about Fixed Deposit and Recurring
 Deposit. Share information on these with your class.
